items.title: Former Hunter coalmine site chosen for train manufacturing facility
items.summary: The development is expected to support up to 780 jobs during construction and about 550 ongoing jobs across the facility and supply chains, the NSW government says.

items.title: What's Wrong With CoreWeave Stock?
items.summary: In just the past month, this once-hot artificial intelligence stock has crashed more than 26%.

items.title: Robot factories and hypersonic missiles: JPMorgan Chase's first $5 billion of defense investments
items.summary: With $5 billion already deployed off its balance sheet, JPMorgan Chase is racing ahead on direct investments in defense tech, hardware and supply chains.

aus.headline: Coalmine Site To Build Trains
aus.body: A former Hunter coalmine site has been chosen to host a new train factory.
aus.why: The NSW government says it could support about 550 ongoing jobs.

us.headline: CoreWeave Shares Slide
us.body: Shares in AI firm CoreWeave are down more than 26% over the past month.
us.why: Shows how fast the mood on once-hot AI stocks can turn.

biz.headline: JPMorgan Puts $5b Into Defence
biz.body: JPMorgan Chase has put $5 billion of its own money into defence tech deals.
biz.why: Big banks are now backing defence tech, hardware and supply chains.
